description: Resume the original saved job anonymously after interruption. Follow continuation for human payment, bounded polling, result review or support; never create a replacement purchase. Completed/partial results may include studio_notes: preserve provenance, warnings and failed tools; BPM/key are estimates requiring review. Keep job references private. Results, costs and notes are not payment/refund confirmation. refund_status_source=local_ledger is reconciliation at refund_checked_at, not a fresh provider query; unconfirmed/needs_review is not a completed refund. Review terminal Checkout billing separately on the result page or the on-demand REST receipt_api_url; that URL is not another MCP tool.

include_waveform_data.description: Optional. Defaults to false so chat agents receive a compact waveform summary plus result_url. Set true only if raw waveform samples are needed.

include_waveform_image.description: Optional. Defaults to true. When the job has waveform data, include a server-rendered PNG as MCP image content so the client can display it without fetching a URL.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by analyze_track or request_payment_link.

name: get_job_status

continuation.description: Advisory saved-job recovery. URLs contain a private job reference. No provider read or settlement verification is performed.

metadata.description: Analysis metadata, including asset type, source hints, library metadata, and confidence policy when available.

result_provenance.description: Per-tool provenance and applicability summary for interpreting detected, audio_candidate (manual review required), filename-sourced, suppressed, or low-confidence results.

result_quality_notes.description: Human-readable quality notes for suppressed, low-confidence, filename-sourced, or review-needed results.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry after changing state or waiting.

studio_notes.description: Optional plain-text project notes for completed/partial usable results. Preserve review warnings, provenance and failed tools. Contains no audio/source URL or payment/refund receipt fields; job references are private.
